front: Who was the first European to reach India by sea in 1498?
back: Vasco da Gama, a Portuguese explorer who sailed around the Cape of Good Hope

front: Which explorer led the first expedition to circumnavigate the globe (1519-1522)?
back: Ferdinand Magellan (though he died in the Philippines; Juan Sebastián Elcano completed the voyage)

front: Who is credited with 'discovering' the Americas in 1492?
back: Christopher Columbus, an Italian navigator sailing for Spain, who reached the Caribbean

front: Which Norwegian explorer led the first expedition to reach the South Pole in 1911?
back: Roald Amundsen, arriving on December 14, 1911 — beating Robert Falcon Scott by 34 days

front: Who was the first European to reach Brazil in 1500?
back: Pedro Álvares Cabral, a Portuguese navigator who landed near present-day Porto Seguro

front: Which explorer is known for mapping much of the Pacific Northwest coast of North America?
back: Captain James Cook, a British Royal Navy officer who made three Pacific voyages

front: Who led the Corps of Discovery expedition across the western United States (1804-1806)?
back: Meriwether Lewis and William Clark

front: Which Venetian merchant traveled the Silk Road to China and served at the court of Kublai Khan?
back: Marco Polo, who documented his travels in 'The Travels of Marco Polo' (c. 1300)

front: Who was the first person to reach the North Pole, traditionally credited in 1909?
back: Robert Peary (though this claim is disputed; Frederick Cook also claimed to have reached it in 1908)

front: Which Portuguese prince sponsored many exploration voyages along the African coast in the 15th century?
back: Henry the Navigator (Infante Dom Henrique), who established a navigation school at Sagres

front: Who led the first European expedition to see the Pacific Ocean from the Americas in 1513?
back: Vasco Núñez de Balboa, a Spanish explorer who crossed the Isthmus of Panama

front: Which explorer conquered the Aztec Empire in 1519-1521?
back: Hernán Cortés, a Spanish conquistador who defeated Montezuma II

front: Who conquered the Inca Empire in 1532-1533?
back: Francisco Pizarro, a Spanish conquistador who captured Emperor Atahualpa

front: Which English privateer was the second person to circumnavigate the globe (1577-1580)?
back: Sir Francis Drake, aboard the Golden Hind

front: Who explored the St. Lawrence River and claimed Canada for France in the 1530s?
back: Jacques Cartier, a French navigator from Saint-Malo

front: Which explorer gave the Pacific Ocean its name in 1520?
back: Ferdinand Magellan, who called it 'Mar Pacífico' (peaceful sea) due to its calm waters

front: Who was the first European to reach Australia's east coast in 1770?
back: Captain James Cook, who mapped the coast and claimed it for Britain as New South Wales

front: Which Moroccan scholar is considered one of history's greatest travelers, covering 120,000 km in the 14th century?
back: Ibn Battuta, who traveled across Africa, Asia, and Europe over nearly 30 years

front: Who led the first successful expedition through the Northwest Passage (1903-1906)?
back: Roald Amundsen, aboard the Gjøa

front: Which Chinese admiral commanded massive treasure fleets across the Indian Ocean in the early 1400s?
back: Zheng He, a Ming dynasty admiral who led seven major expeditions

front: Who was the first woman to fly solo across the Atlantic Ocean in 1932?
back: Amelia Earhart, flying from Newfoundland to Northern Ireland

front: Which explorer discovered the sea route around the southern tip of Africa in 1488?
back: Bartolomeu Dias, a Portuguese navigator who rounded the Cape of Good Hope

front: Who led the expedition that first reached the summit of Mount Everest in 1953?
back: Edmund Hillary (New Zealand) and Tenzing Norgay (Nepal/Tibet)

front: Which Spanish explorer searched for the Fountain of Youth and discovered Florida in 1513?
back: Juan Ponce de León

front: Who was the first person to reach the deepest point in the ocean, the Mariana Trench, in 1960?
back: Jacques Piccard and Don Walsh, aboard the bathyscaphe Trieste

front: Which Viking explorer is believed to have reached North America around 1000 AD?
back: Leif Erikson, who established a settlement at Vinland (likely Newfoundland, Canada)

front: Who explored the Amazon River and became the first European to navigate its entire length in 1542?
back: Francisco de Orellana, a Spanish explorer

front: Which British explorer searched for the source of the Nile and explored Lake Tanganyika?
back: Richard Francis Burton and John Hanning Speke (1850s-1860s)

front: Who was the first person to sail solo around the world (1895-1898)?
back: Joshua Slocum, a Canadian-American sailor aboard the Spray

front: Which explorer mapped much of the African interior and was famously 'found' by Henry Morton Stanley?
back: David Livingstone, a Scottish missionary and explorer ('Dr. Livingstone, I presume?')
